source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: In entry 2137 and fixed0b93, writeUpdateAutoPref waits for the disk write and a minimum-disabled-control promise, updates dependent controls and, when disabling automatic updates, awaits checkUpdateInProgress. It then dispatches ProcessedUpdatePrefChange. Its catch rereads/reports and returns before that event. The event describes this settings path, not completed background updating or a failure notification. The explicit1000ms production interval does not authorize arbitrary sleeps in tests. No direct event assertion was found in the scoped current comm preference tests, and no runtime/error injection ran.
title: The update preference completion event belongs to the successful settings path
